claim.claim-text: 1. A method of simultaneously extracting two or more mycotoxins from foodstuffs, comprising: contacting said foodstuffs with a aqueous composition of beta cyclodextrin not comprising any organic solvent.

2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the two or more mycotoxins extracted from the foodstuff are selected from aflatoxin, ochratoxin, fumonisin, zearalenone, deoxynivalenol, T2 toxin, and ergot toxin.
3. The method according to claim 1, wherein the two or more mycotoxins are extracted with a single aqueous composition.
4. The method according to claim 1, wherein three or more mycotoxins are extracted from the foodstuffs.
5. The method according to claim 1, wherein the aqueous composition further comprises a buffer; optionally, wherein the buffer is a phosphate buffer.
6. The method according to claim 1, wherein the beta cyclodextrin is a hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin.
7. The method according to claim 6, wherein the hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin is a hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin of formula I

wherein n is 7; each R is independently hydrogen or a hydroxypropyl; and an exemplary sample of the hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin of formula I possesses, on average, 0 - 10 hydroxypropyl substituents per hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin molecule.

8. The method according to claim 7, wherein an exemplary sample of the hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin of formula I possesses, on average, 3 - 6 hydroxypropyl substituents per hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin molecule.

9. The method according to claim 8, wherein an exemplary sample of the hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin of formula I possesses, on average, 4.1 - 5.1 hydroxypropyl substituents per hydroxypropyl beta cyclodextrin molecule.
10. The method according to claim 1, wherein the beta cyclodextrin is a standard grade hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin.

13. The method according to any one of claims 1-12, wherein the foodstuff is a grain.

14. The method according to claim 13, wherein the grain is selected from barley, corn, fonio, kamut, millet, oats, popcorn, rice, rye, sorghum, spelt, teff, triticale, wheat, dry distiller grain, and corn gluten meal; optionally, wherein the grain is selected from corn, barley, wheat, and rice.

15. The method according to any one of claims 1-14, wherein the method further comprises removing the composition from the foodstuff; and optionally, contacting the composition with a lateral flow detection apparatus comprising a test strip and mycotoxin detector.
